title: Senior Android Developer
jobDescription:
We are looking for an Senior Android developer responsible for the development of applications aimed at a vast number of diverse Android devices. Your primary focus will be the development of Android applications and their integration with back-end services. You will be working alongside other engineers and developers working on different layers of the infrastructure. Therefore, commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and creating quality products is essential. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and build advanced applications for the Android platform Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features Work with outside data sources and APIs Unit-test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and general reliability Work on bug fixing and improving application performance Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN YOU: 5+ years of experience managing mobile app engineering teams. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment. Attention to details – any code that makes it into the product directly impacts the lives of people being cared for. Strong computer science fundamentals in object-oriented design, algorithms and data structures. Self-starter, analytical and creative. Solid familiarity with off-line first UX/UI, analytics and remote user support in mobile apps. Strong team player with a positive attitude. Able to drive architectural decisions on Android. Strong experience writing clean, testable, high-quality code and designing highly scalable systems in production. Strong advocate of software craftsmanship, object oriented and SOLID principles, and clean code architecture. Good experience with writing unit tests, preferably TDD and BDD. Familiar with git and/or git-flow, Bitbucket, JIRA, Confluence, Bitrise, Opsgenie, Bugfender.

title: Project Consultant
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced technical Project Manager who will join a dynamic and fast-paced environment and work with cross-functional teams to design, build and roll-out products that deliver the company’s vision and strategy. As a Project Manager, you will play a crucial role in overseeing the successful delivery of our mobile app, website, and custom software development projects. You will be responsible for managing the entire project lifecycle, from initiation to closure, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Your strong knowledge of both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, along with a deep understanding of the latest trends in the market, will enable you to make informed decisions and effectively lead your team. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and resource allocation. Execute projects using Agile or Waterfall methodologies, depending on project requirements, ensuring adherence to established processes and standards. Collaborate closely with clients, internal teams, and third-party vendors to gather project requirements, establish clear communication channels, and manage expectations. Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. Lead and motivate cross-functional project teams, including developers, designers, quality assurance, and other stakeholders. Provide clear direction, set expectations, and foster a collaborative work environment. Effectively manage resources and resolve conflicts to ensure project success. Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues. Develop risk management plans and proactively monitor and control risks throughout the project lifecycle. Make informed decisions to minimize potential impacts on project timelines, budget, and quality. Maintain clear and effective communication with clients, team members, and senior management. Provide regular project status updates, conduct project meetings, and prepare comprehensive project documentation and reports. Ensure all stakeholders are well-informed and aligned. Ensure projects adhere to quality standards and meet client expectations. Develop and implement quality control processes, conduct regular reviews, and perform thorough testing to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Stay abreast of the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in mobile app development, website development, and custom software development. Leverage this knowledge to identify opportunities for improvement, drive innovation, and enhance project delivery processes. Make timely and informed decisions based on project priorities, client needs, and business objectives. Evaluate risks and benefits, consult with stakeholders, and leverage your expertise to make effective decisions that drive project success. WHAT WE LOOK FOR IN YOU: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Proven experience 5 years as a Project Manager, preferably in a technology or software development company, with a focus on mobile apps, websites, and custom software development. Strong knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies, with the ability to adapt and apply the appropriate methodology based on project requirements. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with clients, team members, and senior management. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills. Proven track record of successfully delivering projects on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire teams to achieve project goals. Exceptional decision-making skills, with the ability to make informed decisions under pressure and in complex situations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail. Knowledge of the latest trends and technologies in mobile app development, website development, and custom software development. PMP or Agile certifications are a plus.

title: Senior / Digital Marketing Manager
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced and result-driven Digital Marketing Head to join our marketing team! As the Digital Marketing Head at our company, you will be responsible for setting up, implementing and managing the overall company's digital marketing strategy, you should have in-depth marketing experience and a passion for growth, marketing, branding & lead generation. Digital marketing strategies are extremely important to our company's success, so your role will play a crucial role in achieving our business goals and objectives. We are expecting you to have experience and a big passion for digital technologies and various digital marketing channels. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Ability to design end-to-end digital marketing campaign journeys and bring them to life in the way of focused multi-touch demand generation campaigns, utilizing various platforms. Plan and execute all digital marketing, including SEO, SEM, marketing database, email, content syndication, social media, and display advertising campaigns. Must have experience in creating a new strategy for generating leads. Create and implement a digital marketing strategy to drive awareness, traffic, leads, and conversions. Should have experience in paid marketing to look after our paid marketing activities (Google, Facebook, Instagram, Linked In); having good experience in search engine marketing and maximization of ROI in paid search campaigns. Develop and execute the company's paid marketing strategy, including creating and managing campaigns across multiple channels. Develop growth strategies with the sales team to optimize engagement within high-value accounts. Perform in-depth research to identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness. Create, execute, and manage paid media campaigns across different channels, including but not limited to the display, search, paid social media (Linked In), industry. Helping to drive leads and online traffic with web-based activities and programs. Measuring and reporting performance of all digital marketing campaigns and assessing against goals (ROI and KPIs). Executing digital marketing strategies across channels including email, social media, and display advertising campaigns. Continuously test and improve ad creatives, targeting, and bidding strategies to improve campaign performance. Planning, developing and executive account-based Marketing Campaigns. Planning and carrying out webinar strategies, establishing (virtual and live) events to interact with target audience and generate leads. Track, measure, and report on all ABM activity based on Sales KPIs and success. Designing, building, and maintaining organization's social media presence. Plan, setup execute the demand generation programs to generate new leads and increase pipeline velocity through organic and paid marketing campaigns. What We Look For In You: A minimum of 7 years of experience in performance marketing, with experience of leading a team. Strong analytical skill, with the ability to analyze and interpret data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for improvement. Proven experience in paid marketing, with a strong record of accomplishment of success in managing and optimizing campaigns across multiple channels. Familiarity with marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Hub Spot, Marketo, Pardot, or Google Analytics Proven track record with account-based marketing initiatives, targeted vertical campaigns, or demonstrable success impacting pipeline growth. Understand sales processes and objectives of the accounts and work closely to define fitting marketing program to achieve their goals and grow our business. Analyze account strategy, set up marketing plan working closely with the onshore marketing leads. To support the creation and promotion of a set of ABM best practices. Driving maximum ROI from campaigns. Strong team management and communication (written and verbal) skills.
